title: O. Reg. 285/01 s. 1.2 under the Employment Standards Act, 2000: information for a new employee
source: Ontario Regulation 285/01 s. 1.2, added by O. Reg. 477/24 in force 1 July 2025; Employment Standards Act, 2000, S.O. 2000, c. 41, s. 2 (5) and (7). Read on ontario.ca 2026-10-09.
note: A drafting check, not legal advice: the scripted rules read whether a particular is there, never whether a term is lawful.

rules.text: The information is given before the first day of work, or as soon after as reasonably possible when that is not practicable.
The employer's legal name and any operating name; an address, a telephone number and one or more contact names.
Where the employee will first work, the starting wage rate, the pay period and pay day, and the expected first hours.
The employee also gets the Ministry's current Employment Standards Act poster within 30 days.
